_about: The declared credential families. A family groups canonical titles that stay their own titles: each member keeps its identity, its adoption and its exhibits, and carries the family as a field (kb_curation credential_family, carried into kb/credentials.json by kb/_apply_credential_review.py). Each member's component tests are search aliases of it (kb/credential_aliases.py components). A family is never a fold target. Sam's ruling, 2026-11-11 (cpl_memory sam-bundle-family-is-a-field-2026-11-11). A member is a bundle of named tests, all required, and takes the family's naming form (kb/test_mix.py family_read), unless the family lists it under any_one_test: then any one of its tests qualifies, it keeps its own title, and it is never named as a bundle (Sam, Open Asks Sheet 181, 2026-11-11; cpl_memory d-sheet-181-replies-2026-11-11).
_owner: kb/_family_tag_plan.py and the Quick Adopt family worker (S638); other readers only read it

ASE Certificate Bundles.about: A college's own set of ASE tests, required together for its credit; ASE awards each test, never the set.

any_one_test.ASE Certification (any A1–A8): any one of the tests A1 to A8 qualifies
